items.quote: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp
items.claim: A son of an Israelite woman and Egyptian father quarreled with an Israelite man in the camp
items.actor: the son of an Israelitish woman; a man of Israel

items.quote: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed
items.claim: The son blasphemed the Lord's name and cursed

items.quote: And they brought him unto Moses
(and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
items.claim: The mother's name was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan

items.quote: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them
items.claim: They imprisoned him that the Lord's intention might be revealed
items.mechanism: that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them
